items.prompt:
Redraw Image 1 as a SIMPLE economical hand-painted anime martial card 飞身劈. Preserve cropped arms entering upper-left, two hands on ONE short hilt, and ONE descending steel blade along upper-left to lower-right. Body, face, legs and boots stay completely outside frame. Image 2 初始攻击 is the style reference for broad restrained steel planes, quiet surfaces and selective handmade drawing; do not copy its crossed swords. Image 3 惩击 is style only for matte opaque broad color construction and restrained line accents; do not copy character or beam.
Two plain bare hands securely wrap the same short dark sword hilt one above the other; correct the draft's soft/malformed fingers into a readable natural grip. Visible thumbs and grouped curled finger shapes, necessary knuckle contours only, no wrinkles or decorative glove design. Plain charcoal sleeve ends are cropped at top/left edges, wrists connect naturally. Simplify the guard to ONE small dark steel bar; remove all ornamental rings, layered collars and hilt hardware. Broad straight blade has coherent central ridge and two cutting edges, tip can run just beyond lower-right frame. ONE short tapering ivory-gray slash swathe lies beside the tip, showing descending momentum; no target, sparks, blood or other props.
DRAWING: firm sparse dark colored contour accents CLOSE the hand/sleeve/blade forms, varied pressure and thickness, few selective interior lines explain grip and wrist. No hair-thin multiplied contour network or pristine product-render outlining. COLOR: calm connected matte gray-blue steel planes, broad ivory highlight strip, one broad dark side; warm skin with two or three grouped hard shadow turns. A few confident opaque flat-brush strokes run INSIDE these defined shapes. Simplified painted finish, unfinished-edge accents used sparingly, no microfacet mosaic, finely sculpted hands, glossy gradient blade, dense scratches or all-over texture filter. Keep the blade and downward flow dominant; hands stay a small upper-left anchor, not a portrait of fingers.
Quiet muted blue-gray backdrop transitioning into dark burgundy upper-left; no white background, scattered textured patches or landscape. No additional objects, text, frame, watermark or UI.
